results.name: dvd_antisymm
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_antisymm : a ∣ b → b ∣ a → a = b := by
  rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩ ⟨d, hcd⟩
  rw [mul_assoc, eq_comm, mul_right_eq_self₀, mul_eq_one] at hcd
  obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ | rfl := hcd <;> simp

results.name: FirstOrder.Language.Relations.realize_antisymmetric
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem realize_antisymmetric :
    M ⊨ r.antisymmetric ↔ Std.Antisymm fun x y : M => RelMap r ![x, y] := by
  rw [antisymm_def]
  exact forall₂_congr fun _ _ ↦ imp_congr realize_rel₂ <| imp_congr realize_rel₂ .rfl

results.name: AntisymmRel
results.source_text:
/-- The antisymmetrization relation `AntisymmRel r` is defined so that
`AntisymmRel r a b ↔ r a b ∧ r b a`. -/
def AntisymmRel (a b : α) : Prop :=
  r a b ∧ r b a
results.docstring:
The antisymmetrization relation `AntisymmRel r` is defined so that
`AntisymmRel r a b ↔ r a b ∧ r b a`.

results.name: complexLorentzTensor.rightMetric_antisymm
results.source_text:
/-- The right metric is antisymmetric `{εR | β β' = - εR | β' β}ᵀ`. -/
lemma rightMetric_antisymm : {εR | β β' = - (εR| β' β)}ᵀ := by
  apply (Tensor.basis _).repr.injective
  ext b
  rw [permT_basis_repr_symm_apply]
  rw [rightMetric_eq_ofRat, ofRat_basis_repr_apply, ← map_neg, ofRat_basis_repr_apply]
  congr 1
  revert b
  decide
results.docstring: The right metric is antisymmetric `{εR | β β' = - εR | β' β}ᵀ`.

lemma B₅_cubic (S T : (SM 3).Charges) : cubeTriLin B₅ S T =
    (S (15 : Fin 18) * T (15 : Fin 18) - S (16 : Fin 18) * T (16 : Fin 18)) := by
